scope: Question-level evidence review plus reproducible full-roster diagnostics. Not a corrected score.

questions.question: by how much did contingent rental liability decrease from 2007 to 2009?
questions.audit_note: table_2:2007 contingent rent33m to2009 19m. Decrease amount14m; official (19-33)/33=-.42424 is a rate not explicitly requested.

questions.question: what was the percentage change of the net favorable prior period development from 2010 to 2008
questions.audit_note: text_6/7:2010=503m and2008=814m. Question from2010 to2008 suggests (814-503)/503; official reverses direction (503-814)/814.

questions.question: in 2017 what was amount net sales applicable to international market in millions
questions.audit_note: table_5 total5283.3; text_16 25% belongs to security segment, not clearly companywide. Official multiplies company total by security share. text_1 26% relates to plumbing1720.8.

questions.question: what was the percentage change in the common stock and option
questions.audit_note: table_0=21829 and table_3=22203 are categories/total, not two time periods. Official calls their difference over21829 a percentage change.

questions.question: what portion of the adjusted consolidated cash flow for the twelve months ended december 31 , 2005 is related to non-tower cash flow?
questions.audit_note: table_4/5: signed non-tower cashflow-30584 / consolidated531822=-.05751; same period and scale.

questions.question: as of december 312012 what was the percent of the total total freight revenues from agriculture
questions.audit_note: table_1/7:2012 agriculture3280 / total freight19686=.16662; both millions, same2012 column.

questions.question: what portion of the revised purchase price of kichler is dedicated to goodwill?
questions.audit_note: table_5/10: goodwill64m / revised acquisition price549m=.11658.

questions.question: by what percentage will the 2019 pre-tax pension and postretirement expense be higher than that of 2018?
questions.audit_note: text_31: expected2019 expense205m versus2018 160m; (205-160)/160=.28125.

questions.question: what was the difference in operating profit margins as adjusted between 2016 and 2017?
questions.audit_note: table_6:15.7%-15.1%=0.6 percentage points, represented by official .006 as a proportion. Relative percentage change would be a different operation.

questions.question: what percentage of total future minimum operating lease payments for leases with remaining terms greater than one year are due in 2010?
questions.audit_note: table_2/6:2010 lease35269 / total249038=.14162; a percentage question with ratio-form official output.

questions.question: what is the total amount of cash outflow used for shares repurchased during november 2007 , in millions?
questions.audit_note: table_2:431170 shares *48.11 dollars /1000000=20.74359 million; excludes other months.

questions.question: what is the lowest return for the first month of the investment?
questions.audit_note: table_3:100 initial to89.27 yields-.1073 proportional return=-10.73%. Official subtracts only, retaining percentage-number scale-10.73.

questions.question: in 2017 what was the ratio of the htm investment securities ( period-end ) compared to investment securities portfolio ( period 2013end )
questions.audit_note: table_6/7:2017 HTM47733 / investment securities247980=.19249. Ratio explicitly requested; other percent form is a unit-compliance issue.

questions.question: what percentage of total freight revenues was automotive in 2013?
questions.audit_note: table_2/7: automotive2077 / total freight20684=.10042. Official denominator21963 is total operating revenue including other revenue, contradicting question.

questions.question: what percentage of total accounts payable and other current liabilities was accrued casualty costs at december 31 , 2010?
questions.audit_note: table_5/9:2010 casualty325 / total current liabilities2713=.11979.

questions.question: what was the percent of the change in the net revenues from dec . 282012 dec . 29 2013
questions.audit_note: table_1:2012 net revenue53341 to2013 52708; (52708-53341)/53341=-.01187. Year/day OCR strings are awkward but column years establish direction.

questions.question: considering the year 2015 , what was the lowest return for the investment?
questions.audit_note: table_3:2015 value99.90 vs inception100 implies cumulative-.1%; year2015-only return vs2014 105.72 differs. Question does not explicitly specify cumulative. Returning99.90 is asset value, not gain.

questions.question: what was the percentage gain recognized on the commercial mortgages held for sale in 2009
questions.audit_note: text_24/25: gain107m and sales5.4bn. Official107/5.4=19.81481 omits1000 unit conversion; same-units result107/5400=.0198148. Another.3bn sale category also exists. A candidate using table_3 balance1301 chooses a different denominator too.

questions.question: what was the operating margin for 2014?
questions.audit_note: table_1/2:2014 operating income88.2 / sales450.4=.19583.

questions.question: for the five years ended 12/31/2006 what is the performance difference of the class b common stock of united parcel service , inc . and the s&p 500 index?
questions.audit_note: table_1/2:five-year terminal total-return indices148.92 and135.02 (base100); difference13.9 index/percentage points. Official13.9; equivalent ratio difference.139 requires unit context.
